analyst_views.view: Foundation GenAI model spend doubles to $23.4B in 2026; buyers reward cost, latency and reliability proof.
MarketScape Worldwide Foundation Model Software 2026 (Jul 2026) names Google a Leader; other placements paywalled (vendor summary).
Inaugural Wave AI Foundation Models for Language (Q2 2024): Google, Databricks, NVIDIA Leaders; OpenAI, IBM, AWS, Microsoft Strong Performers (press summary; no newer edition found).
Late-2025 enterprise LLM API share: Anthropic 40%, OpenAI 27%, Google 21%; open-weight share fell to 11% (secondary summary; Menlo is an Anthropic investor).
Oct 2026 Intelligence Index led by Claude Opus 5.5, then GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Argon; best open weights are Chinese (GLM-5.3, Kimi K3) (secondary summary).

key_takeaways: Three-way frontier race (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) captures most enterprise API spend; Anthropic leads enterprise and coding share.
Chinese open-weight labs (Zhipu, Moonshot, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax) set the price floor at a fraction of US frontier prices.
Sovereign and private deployment (Mistral, Cohere, IBM, NVIDIA) is the main wedge for challengers in regulated buyers.

trends: Agentic coding is the killer workload, driving token volumes and lab revenue to $60B+ run-rates.
Price war from Chinese open weights: DeepSeek cut V4-Pro API price 75% in May 2026.
Hyperscalers hedge with own models (Microsoft MAI, Amazon Nova 2, Meta Muse) while reselling partner labs.

summary.vc_basis: Not compiled; notable private rounds 2025–26: Crusoe $1.375B + $3.9B, Lambda $1.5B, Nscale $1.1B + $2B, Fluidstack $1.5B, Together $800M

analyst_views.view: Data center systems spend to hit $788B in 2026, up 55.8%, fastest IT segment.
AI infrastructure spend raised to $497B for 2026; ~30% CAGR to 2030.
Neoclouds to earn about $20B in 2026; enterprise deployments roughly triple.
Neoclouds growing 200%+ a year, heading to ~$180B revenue by 2030.
ClusterMAX 3.0 (Sep 2026): CoreWeave and Nebius Platinum; Google, Oracle Gold.
Global capacity to roughly double to ~200 GW by 2030; occupancy near 97%.
Data center capex on track to pass $3T by 2030 on AI buildout.

key_takeaways: Power, not GPUs, is the binding constraint; contracted GW is the new moat.
Hyperscaler backlogs ($496B AWS, $514B GCP, $664B Oracle RPO) dwarf neoclouds.
Neocloud risk is concentration and leverage: Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic anchor most deals.

trends: Gigawatt campuses and behind-the-meter power become standard for frontier labs.
Bitcoin miners convert to SI hosting (IREN, Core Scientific, Applied Digital).
GPU-hour prices firm up as Blackwell/Rubin demand outstrips supply; inference overtakes training.
